done_when: A Telegram media message reaches every account route that text would reach for that chat, proven by a test where a photo for a chat bound only to the second shared-bot account is delivered

findings.body: The only added proof stops at a mocked `onMessage` callback, which returns 'stored' solely from the account ID. It exercises the routing fix but cannot prove actual persistence or delivery: the real callback can reject messages before storage (`apps/core/src/app/bootstrap/channel-persistence-handlers.ts:164–166`). No corresponding end-to-end scenario exists. The review contract and `apps/core/AGENTS.md:110` require this runtime behaviour to be proven through the real runtime and Postgres. Add one automated test using shared bot credentials and a chat bound only to the second account, asserting that the photo reaches that account's route; fake Telegram at its boundary and ensure the test fails without this fix.
